snippet.title: Rogue Command - Roguelite Real-Time Strategy - 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Rogue Command - Roguelite single-player RTS action. True RTS gameplay reinforced reinforced with roguelite build-crafting. 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1461910/Rogue_Command/

Rogue Command our roguelite real-time strategy game is leaving Early Access and going into 1.0. We managed to make Rogue Command exactly the game we wanted to make. 
Made by 2 friends as their first game, it is a true labor of love. An infinitely re-playable single-player RTS. Crammed full of content and ridiculous synergies. Polished through years of user feedback.
The game plays like the classics of the genre. StarCraft and Command & Conquer were the biggest influence for how we wanted the core gameplay to feel. 
And Slay the Spire and Monster Train were big influences in how we wanted the builds to evolve in a run. 
This was just the start, we had learn many lessons in how to actually fit the pieces together in a way that is the most fun. We owe a huge amount of thanks for that to our demo players and the early playtesters and of course the amazing community that has built up around it during Early Access. If you ever gave feedback on our Discord, the Steam Forums or took time to write a review: Thank you!
